name: start_camera_shake

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_StartCameraShake consumes five values, stores the first three as camera-shake amplitudes, the fourth as a mode field, and twice the fifth as a duration before decrementing Script stackTop by five

notes: A positive duration initializes the camera controller at D_003C0D60, sets its camera-shake flag 0x100, and records the three floating-point amplitudes plus mode and duration. A nonpositive duration clears the same flag. The JP corpus contains 78 calls; the dominant parameter sets are (15, 15, 0, 1, 6), (15, 15, 0, 1, 3), and (80, 80, 10, 1, 10).
